title: Time & elapsed duration
sentences: Clock time is based on groups of 60, not 100.
Convert times to a common unit before subtracting.
For an interval crossing midnight, treat the end as part of the next day.
Net time removes breaks from the elapsed duration.
A task runs from 9:40 to 11:15 with a 15-minute break.
10:00 to 11:15 is 75 minutes, so elapsed time is 20 + 75 = 95 minutes.
95 − 15 = 80 minutes of work, or 1 hour 20 minutes.
